decisions.reason: As a recent adjacent extension of the established construction range, it fits existing customers, service routines and parts logistics, so without evidence of results below aspiration levels it would normally be retained.

This articulated dumper remains close to the firm’s core competences and a growing market, and absent clear signs of underperformance a German mid-sized machinery producer would usually continue supporting it.
A multi-model telescopic loader line implies sizable commitment and cross-selling potential with the core business, making withdrawal unlikely unless performance clearly disappointed.
The reported large order and strong rental popularity indicate performance above aspiration for this close-to-core product line, so there is little reason to redeploy resources away from it.

Although this underground mining loader is more distant from the established offer and therefore faces higher review risk, the reported 1,000 operating hours in seven months is a strong enough early signal to keep it on the market.
